title: OnboardingReminder
description: A follow-up sent about an onboarding check - by a person from the board, or by the playbook's stall policy.

sentBy.description: User who sent a manual reminder, or the bot that sent an automatic one.

javaEnums.name: MANUAL
javaEnums.description: Someone nudged the assignees from the board or the wizard.

javaEnums.name: STALL_NOTICE
javaEnums.description: The gate's notifyOnStall policy told the playbook owners.

javaEnums.name: STALL_REASSIGNMENT
javaEnums.description: The gate's reassignOnStall policy moved the task to another role.

javaEnums.name: SOFT_GATE_NOTICE
javaEnums.description: An asset left a non-blocking gate with required checks still open.
